profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, this security services provider specializes in cash logistics, offering tailored solutions to businesses in the financial sector. As a result of increasing demand for secure cash handling and transportation, the company has experienced remarkable growth of 178.7% since its baseline, expanding its workforce to 131 employees in 2024. Its expertise in this niche market has enabled it to establish itself as a trusted partner for companies requiring reliable and efficient cash management services.
